name: Slice of Life: Office Time 1989
source:
In Office Time 1989, you play a recent college graduate who lands a job at a software company (RAITA). Set in a pre-internet world, you help launch a new software product for your company. 

Navigate your everyday life, making choices that shape your future. Will you work or play? Will you find love – or lose it all?

[From [url=https://furnacestreetstudio.itch.io/sol-officeromance89]Itch.io[/url]]
